purpose: Prevent generic multimodal evidence from being applied indiscriminately by freezing the exact biological question each downstream modality may ask of each regular TD candidate.

C1_SHARED_EMERGENT.GSE214979_same_nucleus: test chromatin/regulatory coherence along frozen shared-state coordinates; quantify RNA+ATAC increment and RNA recoverability
C1_SHARED_EMERGENT.Morabito: donor-level transport/recurrence of the shared state with donor ATAC summaries
C1_SHARED_EMERGENT.SCENIC_Stage75: interpret TF/regulatory programs associated with frozen state; no target redefinition
C1_SHARED_EMERGENT.failure_pivot: retain qualified RNA biology if no privileged increment; teacher-private if coherent ATAC increment is RNA-unrecoverable

C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED_IF_ACTIVE.prerequisite: corrected replay must keep C2 active
C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED_IF_ACTIVE.GSE214979_same_nucleus: test whether frozen relational neighbors/edges correspond to regulatory similarity beyond shared-state proximity and technical/operator matching
C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED_IF_ACTIVE.Morabito: donor-level recurrence of relational summaries only; no false cross-nucleus cell pairing
C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED_IF_ACTIVE.SCENIC_Stage75: interpret regulatory structure associated with frozen relational geometry
C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED_IF_ACTIVE.spatial: test tissue localization of relational states where measurable
C2_RELATIONAL_SHARED_IF_ACTIVE.failure_pivot: if relational component fails replay, stop; downstream modalities cannot rescue it

C3_QUERY_MEASURED.GSE214979_same_nucleus: test query-conditioned ATAC/regulatory increment beyond shared state, query abundance, depth/detection and feature support
C3_QUERY_MEASURED.Morabito: donor-level query-program recurrence with separate RNA/ATAC nuclei
C3_QUERY_MEASURED.SCENIC_Stage75: regulatory interpretation of frozen query-conditioned program
C3_QUERY_MEASURED.spatial: query-program localization if panel support exists
C3_QUERY_MEASURED.failure_pivot: if increment is only query abundance/measurement, fail the multimodal interpretation; do not alter q-safety or query definition post hoc

C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.prerequisite: C1 and C3 qualify and C6 shows its own increment
C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.GSE214979_same_nucleus: test whether C6 explains regulatory/chromatin variation beyond the stronger constituent C1 or C3
C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.Morabito: donor-level incremental transport beyond constituent summaries
C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.SCENIC_Stage75: interpret incremental regulatory programs, not merely union constituent annotations
C6_SHARED_QUERY_COMPOSITE.failure_pivot: if multimodal signal is entirely explained by C1/C3, no privileged C6-specific increment; this does not by itself undo RNA C6 qualification

C4_STRUCTURED_COMPOSITE_IF_ACTIVE.prerequisite: C6 qualifies and corrected replay keeps C2/C4 active
C4_STRUCTURED_COMPOSITE_IF_ACTIVE.GSE214979_same_nucleus: test regulatory/chromatin increment of relational structure beyond C6
C4_STRUCTURED_COMPOSITE_IF_ACTIVE.Morabito: donor-level incremental recurrence; no same-cell claims
C4_STRUCTURED_COMPOSITE_IF_ACTIVE.failure_pivot: if no increment beyond C6, multimodal evidence does not support a C4-specific privileged block; relational replay authority remains separate

cross_candidate_rules: All programs/states/contrasts are frozen from lawful RNA evidence before multimodal outcomes are opened.
Use donor-first splits and donor-level replication; nuclei/cells improve precision but do not multiply biological replication.
Same-nucleus claims are permitted only on authenticated same-nucleus surfaces such as GSE214979/qualified SEA-AD multiome.
SCENIC+/Stage75 is an interpretation/prior layer, not validated truth.
Missing modality support is missing evidence, never biological zero.
A coherent but RNA-unrecoverable increment is teacher-private rather than forced into student point prediction.
No downstream modality may rescue a foundation candidate that failed a mandatory upstream gate.
non_authority_statement: Design-only. No target or representation winner and no training authority.
